deviations: Selection-only port: AdaSense's own final DDRM estimate is discarded and every mask is reconstructed by this experiment's two common reconstructors.
Acquisition happens on the shared five-round cadence with exact-cost conjugate-orbit groups rather than AdaSense's own schedule and action space.
Settings are transcribed from the pinned upstream configs/celeba_hq.yml; the upstream code is not executed.
adasense.label: AdaSense matched

deviations: There is no official CelebA entropy benchmark: the settings are the exact official fastMRI ADS configuration transposed to faces, which is an adaptation and not the published face method.
Selection-only port: the ADS diffusion suffix after the last acquisition event and its particle-mean reconstruction are discarded.
Acquisition happens on the shared five-round cadence with exact-cost conjugate-orbit groups rather than ADS's own schedule and action space.
The 10,000-step schedule is truncated onto the 1,000 trained timestep embeddings of this discrete-time prior; upstream's continuous cosine schedule cannot be reproduced exactly.
ads.label: ADS matched adaptation
ads.nondeterminism: ADS backpropagates through the prior; its backward passes are not bit-reproducible, so ads_matched is the one arm whose masks may differ between identical re-runs.
